moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-pointer-highlight-box, written here): Box round the phrase: 1.5 px accent border, radius 3 px, 10 % accent fill, padding 0.3 em left/right, ~0.06 em top/bottom; width and height 0 → 100 % together from a fixed top-left corner, 1 s ease-in-out (CSS (.42,0,.58,1); demo (.65,0,.35,1)), demo from 0.45 s. A pointer arrow (~0.5 em, accent, dark outline) flies in from off-frame bottom-right (0.05–0.45 s, easeOutCubic), then rides the bottom-right corner. Exit fade 2.7–3.0 s; loop 3.2 s. Params: duration (1 s) · padding (0.3 em) · border (1.5 px) · fill: nền mờ (10 %) · pointer: con trỏ ở góc (bật).
